map.📖 查看「用药时间与间隔提醒表 使用指南」: View the Medication Time and Interval Reminder Table User Guide
map.时间轴显示每2小时一格，彩色条块代表该时段需要服用的药物。: The timeline shows one slot every 2 hours, and the coloured blocks represent the medicines to be taken in that period.
map.本工具仅用于辅助生成服药时间表，不替代医嘱: This tool is only for assisting in generating a medication schedule; it does not replace medical advice
map.请严格遵照医生处方和药品说明书服药: Take medicines strictly following the doctor's prescription and the package insert
map.餐前一般指饭前30分钟，餐后一般指饭后30分钟: Before meals generally means 30 minutes before the meal, after meals generally means 30 minutes after the meal
map.数据存储在浏览器本地，清除缓存会丢失，建议打印备份: Data is stored locally in the browser, clearing the cache will lose it, printing a backup is recommended
map.如有药物相互作用疑问，请咨询医生或药师: If you have questions about drug interactions, please consult a doctor or pharmacist
map.📚 深度解析：用药时间与间隔提醒表: In-Depth Analysis: Medication Time and Interval Reminder Table
map.为认知下降或独居老人设置服药、测血压、复诊等提醒，降低遗漏与意外。: Set reminders for medication, blood pressure measurement and follow-up visits for older adults with cognitive decline or living alone, reducing omissions and accidents.
map.按频次（每日/隔日/每周）与首次时间生成提醒时刻表。: Reminder times are generated from the frequency (daily / every other day / weekly) and the first time.
map.提醒宜配合家属同步通知，关键事项保留人工兜底。: Reminders should be paired with simultaneous notification to family, and key items should keep a manual fallback.
map.选择『每日、首次 08:00、共 2 次』，工具生成 08:00 与下一次给药时: Choose 'daily, first at 08:00, 2 times in total'; the tool generates 08:00 and the next dose time, and the full-day schedule can be viewed in the calendar/list view.
map.选择『每周一 09:30 复诊』，生成周期性提醒；与家属端共享，避免老人遗忘导致: Choose 'follow-up every Monday at 09:30', which generates a recurring reminder; share it with the family side to avoid the older adult forgetting and missing doses or follow-ups.
map.提醒能完全替代人工照护吗？: Can reminders fully replace human care?
map.不能。提醒是辅助手段，对认知明显下降者仍需家属/护理员兜底确认执行，关键用药与复: No. Reminders are an aid; for those with clear cognitive decline, family or a carer still has to confirm execution as a fallback, and key medication and follow-ups deserve double reminders.
map.频次怎么选合理？: How to choose a reasonable frequency?
map.严格按医生处方频次设置（如 qd/bid/tid 对应 1/2/3 次/日），改: Set it strictly by the prescribed frequency (e.g. qd/bid/tid corresponds to 1/2/3 times per day); any change must go through medical advice; do not merge dose times on your own for convenience.
